description: Record and verify the email inbox that belongs to THIS agent (not to the person it acts for), so the agent can later sign back in on its own with sign_in_agent. Two steps with the same call: without `code`, Kismet mails a six-digit code to the address; with `code`, the inbox is marked verified. Requires the agent bearer from the device flow or a connector sign-in. An agent address is never used to create a guest account.

code.description: The six-digit code from the mail Kismet sent; omit on the first call.

name: verify_agent_inbox
title: Verify Agent Inbox
